content: DMS native-apk migration complete + harness niri+dinit 59/59. niri.go rewritten (session wrapper dbus, spawns, portals wlr, background-effect strip for niri 25.11, regreet perms); feralos repo bootstrap unconditional; dinit conversion skips session audio; rc-update gated to OpenRC; aports fixes: greetd-dinit sbin path, firewalld --nofork+dbus, elogind dbus dep, cupsd rename, dinit-chimera sysctl helper ignores ENOENT (ipv6.disable=1); harness: apk dms check, vector dinit, serial redial, debug_run virtio-gpu. execfilter repo green (CI x86_64+aarch64). Next: real-hardware NVMe + niri desktop manual test.

Dinit USER services implemented: 6 *-user-dinit aports pkgs (dbus/pipewire/pulse/wireplumber .user services Artix-model: sub-vars, smooth-recovery, dbus pipefd:3 readiness + dinitctl setenv; wait-wayland.user compositor-agnostic socket gate; polkit-agent.user) + dms.user inside dms-shell; niri-session wrapper starts user dinit existence-filtered idempotent; config.kdl spawns removed; harness niri+dinit 61/61. Supervision gap closed: audio/dbus crash-restart native. Next: real-hardware NVMe + desktop manual test.

niri reference-cleanup applied (rounds 24-53): NetworkManager switch (lo-only interfaces, managed=true, plugdev, DMS network/VPN UI, wireguard via NM), wayvnc user-dinit replaces RustDesk flatpak (spawn+firewall removed), scanner stack (sane-airscan/simple-scan), /tmp exec + /var/tmp 1777, CUPS SystemGroup wheel, dinit conversion skips session/NM-managed (pipewire stack, wpa_supplicant, wireguard-tools); aports +networkmanager-dinit +wayvnc-user-dinit; harness niri+dinit 59/59 green. Remaining niri-alpine items NOT ported (VM-only or host-side): eglfilter/execfilter (nix gone), Hyper-V modules, feralos-control/AV bridge, dgop shim (dgop embedded lib in DMS 1.6). Next: real-hardware NVMe + desktop manual test.

Removed @nix-var-nix-build subvolume from all 4 layouts (creation + fstab): nix builds use upstream default build-dir /tmp (exec since noexec removal); daemon creates build dirs itself; 1777 world-writable + TMPDIR scoping + build-dir override all dropped. Subvol count 25->24. Validated harness niri+dinit 59/59.

Nix trusted-users @wheel validation: Phase1 gates caught misspell on 'substituters' comment (reworded to 'cache URLs'). Full harness full_stack.yaml run1 48/50 — nix-channel --update pivot_root EINVAL in chroot (sandbox unpack derivation); fix NIX_CONFIG='sandbox = false' chroot-only (nix.go). Run2 49/50: nix_trusted_wheel/trusted_users_clean/nix_tmp_exec/nix_packages_missing/works_in_real_life all PASS; only log_errors FAIL = udevd /bin/false module noise (parport/psmouse/intel_gtt/input_leds/intel_pmc_bxt, QEMU-only). No cleanup (overall FAIL). CHANGELOG + AGENTS.md Known Issues updated.

AppArmor under dinit wired: apparmor-dinit r4 = scripted loader sourcing Alpine rc.apparmor.functions (openrc logging stubbed) running parse_profiles load; enablement via boot.d symlink from hardening feature; harness chmod_77_check excludes /mnt/tmp sticky 1777; validated 59/59 + 33 profile_load kernel events.

Harness log sweep aggressive (fail/unrecognized/no-such-file) + allowSkip (booster finit default probes, xtrace, runner modprobe); dosfstools added (busybox fsck.vfat stub lacks -C); dinit-chimera r7 fsck-drop-C.patch (busybox fsck lacks -C flag); ESP fsck now runs real fsck.fat 4.2; harness niri+dinit 59/59.

dbus-dinit r5: ready-notification pipefd:3 via --print-address=3 — dinit depends-on gates on bus LIVE (was: process spawned; elogind connected pre-socket ENOENT restart loop). Harness allowRe elogind bus-error lines removed (unmasked). Validated niri+dinit 59/59, 0 bus errors both boots. Lesson: dinit type=process depends-on = spawn-ordering only; use ready-notification pipefd for true readiness.

dinit placeholders eliminated: cpufrequtils/iptables/nftables/fuse converted type=internal -> type=scripted with graceful loaders (cpufreq-set START_OPTS per-CPU; iptables-restore from /etc/iptables/iptables.rules; nft -f /etc/nftables.nft; modprobe fuse — all skip-when-absent, never mask); btrfs-progs-dinit DELETED (chimera early-fs-btrfs covers device scan; btrfs-progs in dinitReplacedByChimera); 24 strays cleaned (21 stale <pkg>-dinit old-gen drafts with WRONG commands e.g. relative paths/wrong targets, 3 _override dirs, dinit-boot-log/src abuild residue). All services now scripted/process with real commands — zero type=internal placeholders. Validated: docker rehearsal + aports CI green + harness niri+dinit 59/59 (early-fs-btrfs active, conversion 9 replaced/0 failed).

Full-features dinit run green. Run1 (2026-09-27T22-12-11Z) 4 FAILs: (1) log_errors — allowRe had 'can't unmount /run/netns' but actual noise 'mount /run/netns/netns-*: Invalid argument' (bare mount variant); (2-4) webmin_container/port/http — PID1 detect 'ps -p 1 -o comm=' unsupported by BusyBox ps → dinit branch never taken → fell back to OpenRC /etc/init.d/webmin-ensure (useless under dinit). Fixes: src/firstBoot/webmin/main.go PID1 via 'cat /proc/1/comm'; service.go allowRe 'mount /run/netns.*Invalid argument' (matches unmount variant too — 'mount' substring of 'unmount'). Run2 (2026-09-27T22-19-17Z) 59/59 PASS — webmin-ensure {+} in dinitctl, nix-daemon {+}, webmin container up on verification boot. Docs: AGENTS.md webmin dual-init + Known Issues netns, docs/architecture/firstboot.md, docs/guides/webmin.md, docs/harness/artifacts.md allowlist note.

DINIT MATRIX COMPLETE — all green: standard_full_dinit 59/59 (all features: sb/tpm/hard/zswap/nix/podman/webmin/debug), server_full_stack 59/59, raid0_full_stack 59/59, unencrypted_full_stack 57/57, kde_full_test 50/50, cosmic_full_test 50/50, niri_full_test 59/59. Fixes this arc: crypttab replaces conf.d/dmcrypt (dinit early-cryptdisks contract — swap LUKS now opened, keyfile /etc/dmcrypt/swap.key); bluez-dinit new (bluetoothd, dbus-gated); sessionSkip extended (alsa-utils/pulseaudio/gnome-keyring/openconnect/vpnc); booster dm-node mount race allowlisted (transient, udev retry recovers); webmin firstBoot dual-init via /proc/1/comm (busybox ps lacks -o comm); nix-daemon dinit enablement boot.d; nix-channel --update at install (sandbox=false chroot-only); nix build-dir upstream default /tmp + @nix-var-nix-build subvol removed.
